The story without the 3D view

The map highlights Washington in the Pacific Northwest, California on the West Coast, and Texas in the south-central United States. Markers identify Redmond, Austin, and a representative point for Silicon Valley near Palo Alto. Alaska and Hawaii appear in labeled insets.

Map data U.S. Atlas state boundaries, derived from U.S. Census Bureau cartographic data. Composite Albers USA projection; Alaska and Hawaii are shown as insets. State heights are equal and do not encode economic data.
